items.title: Download videos as MP4
items.text: Switch to Video and pick the quality you want, all the way up to 4K when the video has it. Up to 1080p you get H.264 MP4s that play everywhere.

items.title: Clip, speed up and crop
items.text: Tap ✂ Edit to keep only the part you want, change the speed from 0.5× to 2×, and crop to 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 or 4:5. Drag the box to choose what stays. Clips and speed work for audio too.

items.title: Never miss what's new
items.text: The first time you open Drop after an update, this screen shows up, even if the helper is still restarting.

items.title: Big playlists download reliably
items.text: Long playlist or song names no longer fail to save, hiccups are retried automatically, and if YouTube starts limiting your connection Drop slows down and tells you. Anything that didn't make it gets a Retry failed button.

items.title: Cleaner Settings
items.text: Settings no longer shows a second outline when you scroll. The card stays put and only its content moves.

items.title: Updates install themselves
items.text: When a new version of Drop is out, it installs on its own. A small window shows the progress, then closes, and Drop restarts on the new version. If you're downloading something, it waits until you're done.

items.title: You'll know when it's done
items.text: After an update, Drop tells you it's up to date and opens this screen with what changed. You can open it again any time from Settings > What's new.

items.title: Your choice
items.text: Prefer to update yourself? Turn off "Install updates automatically" in Settings. Drop will just let you know when there's a new version, and Check for updates looks right away.
